semantics.out_both: For i=0..98, in[i] AND in[i+1]; bit 99 is 0 (original item 1).
semantics.out_any: For i=1..99, in[i] OR in[i-1]; bit 0 is 0 (original item 2).
semantics.out_different: For i=0..98, in[i] XOR in[i+1]; bit 99 is in[99] XOR in[0] (original item 3).
semantics.timing: Combinational, follows current input after simulator settling; no cycle latency, clock, reset, or acceptance protocol is specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement; outputs depend only on current input.

numeric.operations: Single-bit Boolean AND, OR, XOR; no arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow.
numeric.index_order: Left neighbor is the next higher index, except wrapped bit 99 for out_different.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit loop directly implementing original numbered requirements.
cases: every walking one and walking zero
verification.sampling: Drive input, wait 1 ns for combinational settling, compare all 100 bits of all outputs using case inequality.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.
